name: azure-cost-increase-assessment
description: Azure cost advisor for Azure SRE Agent: a short overview of current cost and of announced price increases, then a deep dive on the chosen resource. Includes the price-increase rules, billed-cost retrieval (Cost Details, with the Cost Management Query API as a labelled second source), and active reservations and savings plans. Every skill bundles the Python scripts it runs, so there is no Python tool to create and no Code Access to connect. Read-only.
